name: Choukyou M Ecstasy
source:
This is the story of an ordinary university student living in an apartment complex who met a woman. When he went to deliver "certain goods" that she'd dropped, his destiny changed. He can't escape from the the training which began from a misunderstanding even though he wants to, and pain and pleasure battle each other as he reaches the pinnacle of shame.

A no-role-reversal, female superiority submission AVG choukyou story.
translation:
一名住在公寓里的普通大学生，偶然遇见了一名女子。他归还对方掉落的“某件物品”后，命运从此改变。尽管他想逃离，却无法摆脱因误会而开始的调教；痛苦与快感交织，最终将他推向屈辱的顶点。

这是一部没有角色立场反转、以女性支配为主题的调教类AVG。
